title: Life Core JSON boundary
description: Owned by life-data. Wire shapes and current operations only; platform dependencies and sync policy are implemented in TypeScript.

skippedTables.description: Tables skipped in the last completed pull round, including rounds with rejected pushes. Empty when no skip history is stored; not a coverage or freshness certificate.

dayStartMinutes.description: Version 2 host calendar policy: integer minutes after local midnight, 0 through 1439. Omitted means 0. Applied with timeZone to runtime CalendarContext, never persisted as resolved timestamps.

SavedViewDefinition.description: columns is SQL projection and may omit id, updated_at and hidden fields; fetch a full row before editing. For visible layout only, omit columns when querying rows.

SaveViewArgs.description: expectedUpdatedAt is required when id is supplied; omit both to create a new view.

Writeability.description: Advisory table guards only. writeRow rechecks under its writer transaction; coverage is not a simultaneous or current remote snapshot.

RemoteRecord.description: Transient read-only hub row, including all locally known physical columns. deleted explicitly identifies tombstones. Never pass this record to the local writer or imply it is locally replicated.

RemoteRowsArgs.description: One online page in source ID order; default limit 50, maximum 200. Pass nextCursor unchanged; omit cursor to refresh. No text search, arbitrary filters, sorting, count or snapshot guarantee.

RemoteRowsPage.description: Transient page including tombstones. A full page may require an empty terminal request. Across a changing hub, clients deduplicate repeated record IDs before keyed rendering, replacing the displayed record with the later response; this does not establish a snapshot.

RemoteRowArgs.description: One online ID lookup using the source column collation; the returned ID retains its stored spelling.

UndoAction.description: One volatile last saved change in this opened workspace session. receiptId is opaque; clients never supply inverse data. Each autosave replaces the previous action.

SessionReply.description: Host supplies HTTP status, bounded parsed JSON on 200 or null otherwise. Never derive status from error strings. Optional Retry-After delay is parsed by the host without platform clocks in core.

EnrollmentPollResult.description: Approved means the candidate identity was authenticated. Hosts must also require session.replica.allowed before installing it for replica use. Pending never distinguishes an unapproved token from a revoked one.

SessionRevocationResult.description: Unauthorized is not proof that an unregistered approval URL has been cancelled; a later browser approval remains possible.

RejectedEdit.description: Durable submitted snapshot and unchanged hub rejection objects, not the current local row. IDs preserve exact string bytes. Re-read a full local row and use its current revision before repair; only accepted sync receipts clear the inbox.

RejectionsArgs.description: Offset pagination over the current local inbox, ordered by binary table and row ID. Default limit 100, maximum 200; default offset 0. Restart at offset 0 after sync changes the inbox; pages are not a cross-request snapshot.

HubSession.description: Wire session identity. Absent capabilities are legacy only; explicit capabilities require schema full-ddl-v1 and replica_sync true before replica enrollment. Consumer enrollment still rejects admin credentials.

ScopedReplicaUnsupported.description: HTTP 403. Canonical message and response fixture: tests/fixtures/hub-capabilities-contract.json.

rows.description: columns is SQL projection and may omit id, updated_at and hidden fields; fetch a full row before editing. For visible layout only, omit columns when querying rows.

listViews.description: columns is SQL projection and may omit id, updated_at and hidden fields; fetch a full row before editing. For visible layout only, omit columns when querying rows.

saveView.description: expectedUpdatedAt is required when id is supplied; omit both to create a new view.

writeability.description: Read-only advisory. Always use write for the transactionally rechecked mutation.

remoteRows.description: One bounded hub pull with no local row, checkpoint, coverage or outbox writes. A matching durable endpoint binding and local schema are required. Remote results are read-only.

remoteRow.description: One bounded hub pull by ID; null means no matching row. Tombstones remain explicit. A matching durable endpoint binding and local schema are required.

undoStatus.description: Read this handler instance's last saved change after queued session mutations settle. Closing the workspace discards the receipt. This is not a history query or a guarantee that undo will pass current validation.

undo.description: Undo last saved change through the ordinary validated writer, requiring the captured revision and shape. Success consumes the receipt; failure preserves it. No redo or timestamp restoration. Hosts pause autosave and preserve newer drafts for explicit review.

enrollmentApproval.description: Pure relative approval path and public fingerprint code. Hosts validate/canonicalize the endpoint and generate/hash the candidate token; core never receives it.

validateDeviceSession.description: Pure nonadmin identity validation and current full-scope replica eligibility. Dedicated manual names are allowed. No network or storage.

enrollmentPollResult.description: Pure classification of one bounded session response, matching device:<fingerprint> only on approval. Hosts own deadline/cancellation and cap the returned retry delay to remaining time; never poll after the deadline.

sessionRevocationResult.description: Pure classification of session POST. Only 200 with logged_out true confirms revocation; 401 is separately unauthorized, never proof that future approval is impossible.

referenceSources.description: Incoming live catalog ref/multi_ref definitions and persisted skipped-source warnings; no source row scans. Hosts load groups lazily.

referencedBy.description: One bounded local incoming-reference group. Default 20 rows, maximum 100, live sources only. Target identity uses its primary-key collation, including trashed targets. Hosts ignore stale replies and re-read a row before opening it.

rejections.description: Read the durable local rejection inbox without initialization or mutation. Missing storage is empty; malformed persisted data fails the whole page without skipping or deleting entries. An unchanged inbox has exact terminal detection, including a full final page.

resolveSourceLink.description: Resolve supported external source URLs through live whole-record imported_from provenance. Missing mappings remain external; ambiguous identities fail. Hosts re-resolve the destination before guarded navigation.
